source: scope contents(path: String) { path "contents/{*path}"; }
GET list() -> Vec<Task>;
METHOD "PURGE" purge(key: String) { path "cache/{key}"; }
part keyed(idempotency_key: String) { headers { "idempotency-key" = idempotency_key; } idempotent; }
GET files(..paged) -> Vec<DiffEntry> { path "files"; }
scope bucket(name: String) { base "{name}.{client.endpoint}"; }
